status: Prototype; not a finished Johto or owner-approved release

actual_controller_results.genuine_QA10_save: Normal cold Continue at old (22,7) to relocated open (22,8); exact party/boxes/flags/starter/decoded money and inventory preserved; source battery unmodified. One sample does not establish all old-save compatibility.
actual_controller_results.visibility: On SHORT_GRASS behavior 0x07, 5 of 192 Joe opaque pixels in bottom two sprite rows are masked by grass; on ordinary floor, all 183 opaque pixels visible. Earlier unconditional 192/192 failed; semantic check restricts exception to SHORT_GRASS and feet only.
actual_controller_results.travel: Normal controller crossing Azalea/Route33 seam in both directions and Route33/Union Cave warp roundtrip; normal in-game Save and cold Continue.
actual_controller_results.collision: 39 sampled solid-boundary approaches and four directional ledge jumps passed, each jump checked against predicted actual destination. No sampled unsafe jump was skipped. This is not every tile or approach.
actual_controller_results.interactions: One preserved resident and both preserved signs were activated by A.

actual_compiled_runtime_checks.limitations: Checks source vs actual linked ROM and live Route33 VRAM; primary animation tiles excluded; no full visual acceptance.

fixtures: Copied owner-independent QA10 battery, ordinary in-game save; shared harness disables random encounters in RAM and uses actual Survey desk interaction. No map/warp/position writes. No saves or snapshots in this public evidence.
